params.q: What is the fine for drunk driving in India for a first offence?

search_parameters.q: What is the fine for drunk driving in India for a first offence?

response.header: For a first-time drunk driving offence in India, the legal penalty is a fine of Rs 10,000 and/or up to six months of imprisonment under Section 185 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 as amended by the 2019 amendment.

text_blocks.snippet: The monetary fine for a first offence is Rs 10,000, which was increased five-fold from the pre-2019 amount of Rs 2,000 to enhance deterrence +1 .

In addition to the fine, a first offence may also attract imprisonment for up to six months. Courts often exercise discretion, and for first-time offenders without involvement in accidents, typically only the fine and license suspension are imposed .
snippet_highlighted_words: first offence may also attract imprisonment for up to six months

text_blocks.snippet: Conviction usually results in a minimum six-month suspension of the driving licence. After the suspension period, the driver may need to apply for reinstatement, and in some states, a fresh driving test may be required .
snippet_highlighted_words: minimum six-month suspension of the driving licence

list.snippet: The legal blood alcohol concentration (BAC) for private drivers is 0.03% (30 mg per 100 ml of blood).
snippet_highlighted_words: legal blood alcohol concentration (BAC) for private drivers is 0.03%

list.snippet: Commercial drivers have a zero-tolerance policy.
Enforcement is conducted using roadside breathalyser tests, followed by confirmatory blood tests if needed 1 . Refusing testing itself can be treated as a legal violation.

text_blocks.snippet: Driving above the BAC limit can invalidate insurance claims for any damages or injuries caused during the incident. Any accidents resulting from drunk driving could also attract additional criminal liability under the Indian Penal Code .

In summary, first-time drunk driving in India is treated strictly, combining a significant fine, potential imprisonment, and licence suspension, with broader legal and insurance implications beyond the immediate penalty BankBazaar+1 .
snippet_highlighted_words: first-time drunk driving in India is treated strictly

references.title: India Drunk Driving Penalty (2026) | PlainLawGuide
references.snippet: A first conviction attracts imprisonment up to six months, a fine up to ₹10,000, or both. For a second or subsequent conviction within three years, the punishment escalates to imprisonment up to two years, a fine up to ₹15,000, or both — plus cancellation of the driving licence for seven years.

references.title: Motor Vehicles Act Penalties India — Challan & Fines Guide
